rationale: S-0015-04 proposes building a minimal DSGC compartmental model implementing the t0015 6-point specification (morphology, d_lambda, DS mechanism, passive parameters, validation, etc.). t0052 (minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba) and t0053 (minimal_dsgc_spatial_gaba) have built minimal from-scratch DSGC models on the dsgc-baseline-morphology-calibrated, with classical EPSP / IPSP kinetics, two parallel inhibition mechanisms (scalar gabaMOD and spatial centripetal-only), passive dendrites, and soma + AIS HH. The 6-point cable-theory specification is satisfied across the t0052 / t0053 implementations. Rejecting as covered.
